current.title: AirAsia celebrates return of Ahmedabad and Amritsar flights with a special sale
current.detail: To commemorate the long-awaited return of its Ahmedabad and Amritsar routes, AirAsia will be offering its guests special fares to these two vibrant Indian cities with limited time all-in one-way fares

current.title: AirAsia tawar tambang promosi istimewa sempena kembalinya penerbangan ke Ahmedabad dan Amritsar
current.detail: Sempena kembalinya laluan Ahmedabad dan Amritsar yang dinanti-nantikan, AirAsia menawarkan tambang istimewa bagi penerbangan ke dua destinasi ikonik di India ini, dengan tambang termasuk semua sehala
